## About
MOTEC Auto Care is a proud veteran and local family owned business, and a full-service, ASE Certified automotive repair center in Miramar, San Diego.
Our technicians do extensive inspections and explain what your vehicle needs in plain language. We aim for fair prices on parts and labor and a good experience for every guest who walks in.
Neighbors have rated us 4.7 from 125 Google reviews. Reviewers mention Nick, our service manager, plus Adolfo, Raul and Jr by name, and that means a lot to us.

## Services
- Engine Repair: Diesel or gasoline, we'll take care of drivetrain issues with trusted, certified technicians.
- Transmission Repair: Whatever the mileage, we service your transmission following the manufacturer's guidelines and give your car a courtesy check.
- Brake Services: Brake work for your daily driver, done by our own technicians.
- Suspension Services: Suspension work to keep your car riding right.
- Car Tune Up / Diagnostics: We use current technology and diagnostic tools to find and fix what's going on.
- Multi-Point / Pre-purchase Inspections: Multipoint inspections done according to your vehicle's manufacturer recommendations.
- Oil Changes / Fluids: Regular oil changes and fluid service to keep things running properly.
- Auto Body Collision: From consultation to completion, with accurate timeframe and pricing estimates and attention to detail.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: No appointment necessary. Come in anytime during our hours.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you work on my make?
A: We repair vehicles of all makes and models here in San Diego, including Audi, BMW, Toyota, Hyundai, Lexus, Mazda, Volkswagen and Mercedes.

Q: Will you keep me updated on my car?
A: Yes. One reviewer said we kept them updated through the entire repair, and another said we follow up after the work is done.
